desc: 糖果粉撞色卡通印花，三层褶皱亲肤，加宽耳带不勒耳
leaf: 一次性卡通印花三层平面褶皱口罩
name: 卡通印花三层褶皱平面口罩款

shots.intent: 首屏用粉绿糖果撞色与满版卡通印花抓住所购人群，一眼看清印花平面口罩本体加盒装的组合。
shots.textZone: upper cream #FFF6F4 band for headline plus one sub-line; a row of dot-flanked pill labels beneath

shots.intent: 用三张日常出行环境的实拍格把扬尘、柳絮与尾气颗粒讲成换口罩的理由，只讲环境困扰不讲病理。
shots.textZone: headline across the top, one short dot-flanked label under each frame

shots.intent: 把六个佩戴体验点拆成统一图标卡阵，形成结构化记忆并承接品牌承诺标题。
shots.textZone: headline centred at the top, one short label under each of the six icon cards

shots.intent: 上下两排同框对照普通款的厚闷与细硬耳带，把轻薄透气与加宽耳带转成可见差异。
shots.textZone: two row headlines and one pill label per column per row

shots.intent: 俯视平铺三层布片与对应名称位，让买家看懂每一层是什么布、花在哪。
shots.textZone: headline top-left, one material label plus one short sub-label inside each of the three pills

shots.intent: 微距揭开表层露出内芯布层纤维，把用料讲成看得见的质感而非数字。
shots.textZone: headline block in the upper left, one short label in a lower corner

shots.intent: 并排两张做工特写讲超声焊点与边缘包边，回应脱落与毛边疑虑。
shots.textZone: headline above the pair, one dot-flanked caption beneath each macro frame

shots.intent: 让家长与孩子在真实街头光线下背向出镜，把印花口罩放进四季日常通勤画面。
shots.textZone: clean upper band for one headline plus one short line

shots.intent: 俯视平铺印花款与素色配色，让买家一次看清可选花色并判断尺寸比例。
shots.textZone: three short labels along the bottom card band

shots.intent: 用规整的字段化参数卡承接产品身份与花色信息，数值槽留白待真实资料后期合成。
shots.textZone: centred headline, five coral-rose field chips down the left of the card, blank value slots to the right

shots.intent: 以四条佩戴与存放须知加一枚短按钮收口，完成提醒与加购转化而不依赖任何资质承诺。
shots.textZone: headline at the top, four short reminder lines on the card, one rounded coral-rose button beneath

style.backgroundSystem: flat rounded-corner candy colour-block boards, misty pink #F8D3D8 alternating with mint #CFE8E1 on a cream #FFF6F4 base, each screen carrying inset frames with a 3px #FFFFFF outline, a heavy 24-unit corner radius and one soft diffused drop shadow; scalloped mint #CFE8E1 cloud edging at the outer borders; never a gradient wash, never a stepped plinth, never a clinical or tiled space
style.direction: warm pastel candy-block family daily-wear ecommerce
style.iconSystem: filled flat disc icons in coral-rose #EE6E85 seated inside arch-topped cream #FFF6F4 cards, dot-flanked short labels, one warm apricot #E9915A highlight per icon, identical stroke weight everywhere, no thin-line outline circle style
style.lightingSystem: warm daylight-balanced 4300K studio light, soft front-right key with a low warm bounce, pillow-soft shadows always falling to the left and slightly back, no rim streak, no specular hotspot, identical direction across the whole set
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm pastel candy-block family daily-wear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream base board #FFF6F4, misty pink #F8D3D8 and mint #CFE8E1 blocks, one coral-rose accent #EE6E85, one warm apricot highlight #E9915A, and deep teal-slate text #2E4F5A; warm 4300K daylight-balanced studio light with a soft front-right key, low warm bounce and pillow-soft shadows falling to the left; flat rounded-corner colour-block boards with inset cream frames, a 3px #FFFFFF outline, a heavy corner radius and one soft diffused drop shadow, never a gradient wash or a clinical space; rounded friendly sans-serif only; filled flat disc icons inside arch-topped cards with dot-flanked labels; the flat three-pleat printed mask keeps its three horizontal pleats, hidden single nose wire, thin round elastic ear loops, ultrasonic dotted side welds and its all-over apricot #E3A57C bear and raspberry #D9546A berry print on an off-white #FBF8F4 ground at identical scale and orientation; stable product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no percentage or grade code rendered, no medical or clinical framing.
noDrift: no gradient background or 3D plinth replacing the flat candy colour-block boards
no cool blue studio scheme; this set is warm 4300K pastel pink and mint
no thin-line outline circle icon style; icons stay filled flat discs inside arch-topped cards
no filtration percentage of any kind and no BFE or PFE figure
no pathogen, virus, bacteria, germ or smog-harm claim and no antibacterial, antiviral or allergen-free claim
no medical, surgical, clinical or isolation wording anywhere, including on the carton artwork
no standard or grade code such as KN95, N95, GB 2626, YY 0469 or EN 14683
no test report, laboratory figure, certification mark or seal text
no clinical setting, hospital, clinic or healthcare worker
no identifiable human face; any wearer is cropped above the jaw or turned away
no QR code, membership badge, contact block or price figure
no altered pleat count, nose-clip shape, ear-loop construction, edge binding, cup form or colour
no change to the all-over print motif, scale or orientation
style.presentationRules: keep the flat three-pleat rectangular body, the three horizontal pleats, the single nose wire hidden inside the top hem, the thin round elastic ear loops, the ultrasonic dotted side weld seams and the all-over apricot #E3A57C bear plus raspberry #D9546A berry print on an off-white #FBF8F4 ground exactly as in the reference; identical print scale, orientation and density in every shot; stable product angle and centring
style.surfaceSystem: matte pastel paper board and cream #FFF6F4 card stock with a faint paper tooth, one warm nubby cream #F4EDE4 terry-linen textile for the lifestyle screen; real spun-bonded non-woven fabric texture on the product itself
style.typography: rounded friendly Chinese sans-serif only, generous letter spacing, headline at most 15 chars in deep teal-slate #2E4F5A or coral-rose #EE6E85 depending on the board underneath, two to six short pill labels, no dense body text, no digits rendered by the model
